It feels like the safest path forward is to keep our conversations open and see who naturally gravitates toward the center. If someone is pulling back or speaking in vague circles, I'd want to know what specific words they're using that make them seem distant. What do you think? Does anyone else feel like we're already sensing some tension, or are we just starting to get a read on each other?
